usage: Protocol cross-check only after implementing the site's observed SSR markup. No Kotlin/APK code is executed or bundled. AsuraScans extends KeiSource directly, not a shared multisrc engine.
scope: Cross-check Astro SSR tuples, public_url versus stable seriesSlug, eight-character rotating URL suffix, chapter numbers, page arrays and locked/tiled variants. Node Comics uses the observed comic-only SSR name search instead of upstream API search. Account tokens, premium API access, recommendations, preference migrations and tile decoding are not implemented; nonempty tile mappings fail explicitly.
